source.description: A reviewed six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet showing one consistent retro lava lamp progressing from pale construction to bold felt-tip outlines and saturated marker color.
source.notes: Keep one upright slight-three-quarter lava lamp with one flared base, one curved glass chamber, one tapered cap, four large wax blobs, two small wax bubbles, one long glass highlight gap, two short metal highlight gaps, three base seam accents, and one shallow oval shadow stable. No face, lettering, logo, cord, switch, table scene, sticker border, badge frame, extra lamp, labels, arrows, numbers, fake UI, signature, watermark, or final-only blob.

process_strategy: Lock the lamp axis, flared base, glass chamber, cap, wax routes, highlight gaps, and shadow in pale construction; establish every lamp and wax contour before inking; then color only the already visible metal, glass, wax, and shadow shapes so the finish stays cumulative, face-free, and handmade.

final_elements.name: center axis, base trapezoid, glass chamber, cap, four large wax footprints, two bubble guides, highlight reserves, and shadow guide
final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes one upright lamp, its slight three-quarter taper, the exact four large wax footprints and two bubble positions used later, three highlight reserves, and one shallow oval shadow.

final_elements.name: complete flared base, curved glass chamber, tapered cap, and glass rims
final_elements.description: A single readable outside contour establishes the retro lamp silhouette and the boundaries between metal and glass.

final_elements.name: refined wax contours and open highlight gaps
final_elements.description: The four established wax footprints and two bubble guides are refined into confident irregular contours while the established highlights stay open.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outlines, three base seam accents, and clarified glass overlaps
final_elements.description: Imperfect bold outlines reinforce every established lamp, wax, rim, seam, and shadow edge without adding a new form.

final_elements.name: indigo metal, coral-orange wax, pale-aqua glass, magenta bubble accents, and warm-gray shadow
final_elements.description: Saturated marker fills separate the metal, glass, wax, value accents, and ground shadow with visible streaks and paper highlights.

rejection_checks: The same upright lamp, slight three-quarter taper, base width, glass chamber, cap, wax positions, highlight gaps, and oval shadow must persist through all six panels.
Exactly one lamp, one base, one chamber, one cap, four large wax blobs, two small bubbles, one long glass highlight, and two short metal highlights must appear before the final panel and persist.
No face, letter, word, logo, cord, switch, table scene, sticker outline, badge frame, extra lamp, prop, label, arrow, number, fake UI, signature, watermark, or final-only blob may appear.

The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and handmade edge variation rather than glossy vector-icon polish, glass-like photorealism, or airbrushed gradients, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
